title: Spicy Slovakian Pork Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful Slovakian dish made with pork, peppers, and spices, all cooked to perfection in a skillet.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pork cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the chopped red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the pork back into the skillet, along with the paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the pork is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
